title: 第1217章 真仙云集天仙莅临第1216章 立宗大典
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 一月之期，如约而至。
造化仙宗之主·第一御极释放《皇极经世书》雄浑法力，传遍宗门：“立宗大典开始。”
“开阵法，立仙宗，迎宾客。”
《皇极经世书》乃第一御极自创仙法，法力运转之际，金光如潮，声传方圆二百万里。
每一个字都如同天地法旨，落入造化仙宗每一个修士耳中，令人心生肃穆。
造化仙宗经过百年时间扎根，宗门总面积覆盖方圆二百万里，九阶灵脉之下，是无数附庸势力、附庸宗门。
最初的三万大乘初期以上修士，已经扩充至十几万修士生灵，仙苗数以万计，附庸大乘期势力上万、合体附庸势力数万。
此时此刻，造化仙宗上至真仙、下至合体生灵，十几万修士齐齐高喝："开阵法，立仙宗，迎宾客。"
十几万修士齐齐抬手，法力注入宗门阵法，一座座阵法开启。
从外门开始，最低七阶阵法，往上是八阶阵法、九阶阵法，一阶仙阵、二阶仙阵、三阶仙阵，以及四阶仙阵。
轰隆隆！
大大小小阵法数十上百，拱卫天仙大阵，成为天仙大阵的触手，延伸至方圆二百万里每一个角落。
阵法层层开启，如同天门洞开。
七阶阵法光幕散去，露出八阶阵法的流光；八阶阵法光幕散去，露出九阶阵法的瑞霭；九阶阵法散去，仙阵之光始现。
层层叠叠的阵法光幕逐一消融，造化仙宗的全貌终于展现在天地之间。
方圆二百万里，仙脉纵横，群山如龙，仙气氤氲如海。
三阶仙脉之上，长老仙府星罗棋布。
四阶巅峰仙脉之上，太上长老仙府与宗主仙府巍然矗立，天仙大阵光幕流转，如同一面巨大的琉璃罩，将整座宗门笼罩其中。
阵法打开之时，四面八方，道道光影飞来。
“恭贺造化仙宗立派！”
一道道光影由远及近而来，显化真仙法相。
有真仙人族修士横渡长空、有真仙飞禽双翼犹如垂天之云、有真仙走兽担山赶月而来、亦有古老仙族后裔乘坐古老仙舟……
雷火焚苍域三千万里疆域之内，凡是接到请柬的真仙势力，无一缺席。
他们来此只有一个目的，前来观礼，前来见证一座庞然大物的诞生。
一名魔修老者，真仙巅峰，倒吸一口凉气：“造化仙宗才扎根此地百年，竟已有了天仙大宗之气派。”
“天仙大阵竟然多达三座？难道短短百年岁月，除了原先的大阵，他们又自己布置了两座天仙大阵？”
“这可是天仙大阵啊。”
天仙大阵，一座便足以镇宗立派，三座天仙大阵，放眼雷部二十四域，也是底蕴深厚的老牌天仙宗门才能拥有的阵法配置。
一座新兴宗门，百年之内连布三座天仙大阵，这等底蕴，令人瞠目。
一名真仙巅峰大笑：“哈哈，司徒老魔，以造化仙宗太上长老十绝仙子一刻钟便降服天仙大阵的本领，百年时间打造两座天仙初期杀阵，轻而易举。”
四阶、五阶、六阶仙阵，对应天仙初期、中期、后期战力。
七阶仙丹、七阶仙阵、七阶仙器，放眼整个封神大世界，都是屈指可数之物，只有金仙老祖才够资格拥有。
司徒老魔点头：“也是。”
“看来我雷火焚苍域，要迎来一域之主了。”
造化仙宗是当之无愧的一域霸主，只要获得神道之力加持，便可诞生域主，更加名正言顺执掌一座大域。
司徒老魔望向造化仙宗山门方向，眼中闪过一丝复杂之色。
百年前他还曾与李青元在那座古老秘境中斗法，那时他尚觉得这批飞升者不过是外来户，不足为虑，结果那一战，李青元夫妻与他战平。
要不了多久，李青元这些后起之秀便要彻底超越他们。
很快，三十三名真仙生灵抵达造化仙宗，纷纷献上贺礼祝贺：“我等恭贺造化仙宗立派！
副宗主李青元光影一闪，飞空万里，抱拳相迎：“造化仙宗欢迎各位道友，请入座。”
李青元如今在雷火焚苍域已是赫赫有名，百年前那场与真仙巅峰司徒老魔的斗法，早已传遍三千万里疆域，真仙初期搏杀真仙巅峰不落下风，这份战力足以让任何真仙心生敬畏。
真仙修士入座，他们的仆从、坐骑大多都是渡劫仙尊、大乘期，自然交给大乘期修士去招待。
观礼台设于造化仙宗山门之外，阵法光幕之内，可容纳数万修士。
真仙居上座，渡劫仙尊居中，大乘道尊居下，井然有序。
content_en:
The January period arrived as promised.
The leader of the Creation Immortal Sect, the First Yuji, released the powerful magic power of the "Huangji Jingshi Shu" and spread throughout the sect: "The sect establishment ceremony begins."
"Open the formation, establish the Immortal Sect, and welcome guests."
"Huangji Jingshi Shu" is the immortal method created by the First Yuji. When the magic power is operating, the golden light is like a tide, and the sound spreads within a radius of two million miles.
Every word is like the decree of heaven and earth, falling into the ears of every monk in the Creation Immortal Sect, making people feel solemn.
It took a hundred years for the Good Fortune Immortal Sect to take root. The total area of ​​the sect covers a radius of two million miles. Under the ninth-level spiritual veins, there are countless vassal forces and vassal sects.
The original thirty thousand monks in the early stage of Mahayana and above have expanded to hundreds of thousands of monks and souls, tens of thousands of fairy seedlings, tens of thousands of vassal Mahayana stage forces, and tens of thousands of combined vassal forces.
At this moment, hundreds of thousands of monks from the Good Fortune Immortal Sect, ranging from true immortals to fused creatures, shouted together: "Open the formation, establish the Immortal Sect, and welcome the guests."
Hundreds of thousands of monks raised their hands together, pouring mana into the sect's formations, and each formation opened.
Starting from the outer gate, the lowest is the seventh-level formation, and going up are the eighth-level formation, the ninth-level formation, the first-level immortal formation, the second-level immortal formation, the third-level immortal formation, and the fourth-level immortal formation.
Boom!
Dozens of formations, large and small, guard the Celestial Immortal Formation and become the tentacles of the Celestial Immortal Formation, extending to every corner of a two million mile radius.
The formations are opened layer by layer, just like the gate of heaven is opened.
The light curtain of the seventh-order formation dispersed, revealing the flowing light of the eighth-order formation; the light curtain of the eighth-order formation dispersed, revealing the mist of the ninth-order formation; the ninth-order formation dispersed, and the light of the fairy formation began to appear.
The layers of formation light curtains melted one by one, and the full picture of the Creation Immortal Sect was finally revealed between heaven and earth.
Within a radius of two million miles, there are immortal veins crisscrossing the area, the mountains are like dragons, and the immortal energy is as dense as the sea.
Above the third-level immortal veins, the immortal mansions of elders are dotted all over.
On top of the fourth-level peak immortal veins, the Supreme Elder's Immortal Mansion and the Sect Master's Immortal Mansion stood majestically. The light curtain of the Heavenly Immortal Formation circulated like a huge glass cover, covering the entire sect.
When the formation was opened, lights and shadows flew from all directions.
"Congratulations to the Creation Immortal Sect for establishing the sect!"
Rays of light and shadow come from far to near, manifesting the true immortal dharma.
There are true immortal monks flying across the sky, true immortal birds with wings like clouds hanging from the sky, true immortal beasts carrying mountains to catch the moon, and descendants of ancient immortal tribes riding on ancient immortal boats...
Within the 30 million miles of Lei Huo Fen Cang Domain, all the true immortal forces who received the invitation were not absent.
They came here for only one purpose, to watch the ceremony and to witness the birth of a huge thing.
An old demon cultivator, a peak true immortal, took a breath of cold air: "The Creation Immortal Sect has only taken root here for a hundred years, but it has already developed the style of the Celestial Immortal Sect."
"There are actually as many as three Celestial Immortal Formations? Could it be that in just a hundred years, in addition to the original formation, they have also deployed two more Celestial Immortal Formations?"
"This is the Celestial Immortal Formation."
One Celestial Immortal Formation is enough to establish a sect, and three Celestial Immortal Formations, looking at the twenty-four regions of the Lei Department, are also formation configurations that can only be possessed by veteran Celestial Immortal sects with profound foundations.
A new sect has established three immortal formations within a hundred years. This kind of background is astonishing.
A peak True Immortal laughed: "Haha, Old Demon Situ, with the ability of the Supreme Elder of the Creation Immortal Sect, Shi Jue Fairy, to surrender the Celestial Immortal Formation in a quarter of an hour, it is easy to build two Celestial Immortal Initial Killing Formations in a hundred years."
The fourth-level, fifth-level, and sixth-level immortal formations correspond to the early, mid-term, and late-stage combat power of the immortals.
Seventh-level immortal elixirs, seventh-level immortal formations, and seventh-level immortal weapons are all rare in the entire Conferred God World, and only the Golden Immortal Ancestor is qualified to possess them.
Situ Laomo nodded: "Yes."
"It seems that our Thunder Fire Burning Cang Domain is about to welcome a domain lord."
The Creation Immortal Sect is the well-deserved overlord of a domain. As long as it is blessed by the power of the divine way, a domain lord can be born and more legitimately control a large domain.
Situ Laomo looked towards the mountain gate of Good Fortune Immortal Sect, with a complicated look in his eyes.
A hundred years ago, he had a martial arts fight with Li Qingyuan in that ancient secret realm. At that time, he thought that these ascended people were just outsiders and were nothing to worry about. However, in that battle, Li Qingyuan and his wife drew a draw with him.
It won't be long before rising stars like Li Qingyuan will completely surpass them.
Soon, thirty-three true immortal beings arrived at the Creation Immortal Sect, and they all presented congratulatory gifts: "We congratulate the Creation Immortal Sect for establishing the sect!
Deputy Sect Leader Li Qingyuan flashed, flew thousands of miles into the air, and greeted him with clasped fists: "The Good Fortune Immortal Sect welcomes all fellow Taoists, please take a seat. "
Li Qingyuan is now well-known in the Thunder Fire Burning Cang Realm. The battle with Situ Laomo, the peak True Immortal, a hundred years ago has spread throughout the territory of 30 million miles. In the early stage of the True Immortal's fight against the Peak True Immortal, he did not fall behind. This fighting power is enough to make any True Immortal feel in awe.
The True Immortal monks took their seats. Most of their servants and mounts were Tribulation Immortal Lords and Mahayana stage monks, so they were naturally left to the Mahayana stage monks to entertain them.
The viewing platform is located outside the mountain gate of the Creation Immortal Sect, and can accommodate tens of thousands of monks within the formation light curtain.
The True Immortal is at the top, the Tribulation Immortal is in the middle, and the Mahayana Taoist is at the bottom. Everything is in order.
